headline: 2,100 Trillion Won Flowed In During the First Half Alone…Crypto Exchanges Transform Into 24-Hour U.S. Stock Betting Arenas
summary: A CoinGecko and MEXC report says crypto exchanges are expanding around-the-clock, leveraged trading in US stocks and gold. Over 98% of related trades were perpetual futures rather than actual asset transactions.
why: Perpetual futures are derivative contracts with no expiry, and exchanges offering them to crypto clients are an increasingly important bridge between crypto and traditional markets.
